assistant.title: Comment review assistant
assistant.intro: Pick a class and press "Review this class" to flag issues on each comment. To fix something, record or type a request (e.g. "remove the phrase about disrupting in Dat's comment"); the assistant proposes revisions for you to Apply.
assistant.permissionNote: The assistant only suggests — it never approves, rejects or edits by itself. A revision is saved only when you press Apply; the comment stays pending.
